decisions.reason: Confirmed a fatal logic gap: the original Proof 2.1 checks vector-stack relations only over finite quiver quotient bases, while the coefficient presentation admits every finite-type Artin base with affine stabilizers. Proof 3.1 therefore did not establish descent through ambient coefficient equalities. The repair keeps the Statement and proves finiteness for all coefficient generators, checks every relation there, then restricts the resulting realization.

reviews.reason: Repair-author verification: Frobenius contraction across square-zero thickenings gives the unique-lifting property of the fixed-object stack. Scheme etale criteria and openness make its geometric point images disjoint opens in a noetherian space, hence finite in number. Frobenius-invariant isomorphisms descend, so every allowed Artin generator has finite rational-point groupoid. Additive torsors are trivialized by solving b^q-b=-a, the fiber count retains kernel automorphisms, and the full coefficient presentation maps to Q before localization and restriction. The original Statement is unchanged; this is not independent acceptance of my repair.
